event_name: BAHRAIN GRAND PRIX 03 - 05 March 2023 The Stewards From The Stewards To The Team Manager, Scuderia AlphaTauri
offence: Alleged breach of Article 34.14 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 4 (Lando Norris), the driver of Car 21 (Nyck de Vries), team representatives and examined video evidence. The team released Car 21 from its garage when Car 4 was approaching. The driver of Car 21 reacted and stopped before reaching the fast lane. Both drivers reacted in an appropriate manner and no contact occurred.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 21 Alleged Unsafe Release
